messages:
jules_cs: Quick flag 1 Axiom Diagnostics onboarding: their multi-doc summarization + follow-up Q&A is trending worse at the tail. p50 150ms, p95 ~470ms, p99 ~1.4s, avg tokens ~1.2k. Renewal check in 11 days and the product lead called this out as the top risk. Can we propose a conservative, measurable canary thats reversible and easy to explain to the client?

mina_ml: Yup. Idea: split by intent (summary vs interactive QA) and apply different levers. For summaries: compact-int8 with prefix caching. For interactive QA: keep standard model but route very long chats (>1.5k tokens) to a compact-hybrid with int8. That keeps perceived UX for typical chat but reduces cost + tail for doc-heavy flows.

tom_sre: I can stand up two tiny canary pools (summary-canary 4%, qa-long-canary 3%) and implement a route that checks both route_type and token_length. Need the acceptance criteria and a short rollback plan for legal/account.

leah_success: Acceptance criteria should be clear for the renewals team: primary goal p95 < 320ms for the user-facing routes we promise, secondary goal reduce token spend by ~18% while keeping summary quality delta <= 1.0% (ROUGE/semantic). Rollback immediately if client complains in the call or if automated quality checks show >1.2% degradation.

mina_ml: Draft canary config (short):

```yaml
canaries:
  - name: axiom-summary-compact-int8
    pct: 4
    model: redwood/compact-v2
    quant: int8_safe_F
    route_filter: route_type:summary
    cache_prefix: true
    fallback: redwood/llm-standard
  - name: axiom-qa-long-compact
    pct: 3
    model: redwood/compact-hybrid
    quant: int8_safe_F
    route_filter: route_type:interactive, token_length: >1500
    fallback: redwood/llm-standard
metrics:
  - target: p95_latency
    goal: <320ms
  - target: token_cost_per_1k
    goal: -18%
  - target: summary_quality_delta
    goal: <=1.0%
```

mina_ml: Also recommend adding a short client eval step: pick 10 representative threads (long multi-doc + follow-ups) and run diff-checks pre/post. If any of those have meaningful factual drift, auto-trigger rollback.

tom_sre: Routing rule I'll apply (as text): {"route_policy":"route_type_and_length","conditions":[{"route_type":"summary"},{"route_type":"interactive","min_tokens":1500}],"dest_map":{"summary":"axiom-summary-compact-int8","interactive_long":"axiom-qa-long-compact"},"fallback":"llm-standard"} Ill gate both canaries and attach tracing + canary alerts.

ops-bot: Canary pools queued: axiom-summary-compact-int8 (4%), axiom-qa-long-compact (3%). Start epoch 6172843200. Monitoring hooks: p95, error_rate, quality_delta. Alerts configured: p95>320ms, error_rate>1%, quality_delta>1.2%. :satellite:

leah_success: Ill schedule a 30-min enablement call with the Axiom eng team to walk the plan and capture the 8-12 prompts they care about. Contact is jamie@axiomdx.ai, Wed 2:30pm PT. Well ask them to sign off on the 1-page tradeoff doc before we flip the routes.

jules_cs: Can you also add the expected rollback note for legal: "full traffic revert to llm-standard within 5 minutes; canary pools torn down; incident review within 24h". That calms the execs.

mina_ml: Adding one more safety: set automatic fallback threshold on quality checks (if summary_quality_delta on eval set >0.8% for two consecutive hours, route for those keys to fallback). That way we avoid client-facing regressions even if the overall metric is noisy.

tom_sre: Done. Implementing canary gate and fallback rule. Ill post the dashboard link once ready.

leah_success: On the call well also capture subjective acceptance (perceived latency) and whether theyre comfortable with a small quality trade to hit latency/cost. If theyre not, well keep the canaries paused.

jules_cs: Great. Next steps: 1) enablement call Wed 2:30pm PT (leah invites), 2) tom provisions canaries & routes (ops-bot confirmed), 3) mina finalizes eval set + one-pager, 4) monitor 72h, auto-rollback safeguards in place, 5) scale only if p95 <320ms and summary_quality_delta <=1.0%. Ill update the renewal tracker and loop in the account exec if we dont see wins in 72h. :thumbsup:
